items.title: Gogs Vulnerability Enables Attackers to Silently Overwrite Large File Storage Objects
items.description: A critical security flaw has been discovered in a popular open-source, self-hosted Git service, allowing attackers to overwrite Large File Storage (LFS) objects secretly. Tracked as CVE-2026-25921, this maximum-severity vulnerability carries a CVSS 3.1 score of 10.0. It creates a severe risk for software supply-chain attacks. The flaw currently affects Gogs versions 0.14.1 and earlier, […] The…

items.description: An emergency security update has been released to address a newly disclosed .NET Framework vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-26127. This security flaw allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to trigger a Denial-of-Service (DoS) condition on the network. With a CVSS score of 7.5, Microsoft has classified the vulnerability as “Important.” It affects multiple versions of .NET across Windows, […]…
